recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Follow up in the FHIR Extension Pack and tooling to decide whether elementdefinition-graphConstraint should be broadened, whether a separate graphDefinition extension is needed for ElementDefinition.type.profile/current Resource cases, and how rendering/validation support should work.
issue_request: FHIR-32798 is Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked to allow GraphDefinition assertions in ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile and ElementDefinition.type.profile, particularly for resource-valued constraints such as Parameters or Bundle. The accepted resolution changed that into an ElementDefinition extension, described as graphDefinition 0..* canonical(GraphDefinition), covering the current Resource element or a referenced canonical/Reference instance and requiring renderer/validator support.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-32798 was found in the core source history. The same-family FHIR-19653 decision was implemented by commit 226bd94b2c351f386a1f1a0acf2018f4a108649b, which added elementdefinition-graphConstraint on ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile as canonical(GraphDefinition). That implementation covers only the targetProfile/referenced-instance case, and commit dd468d4f1748875a0ce2fb06ed0799d592f5f2e3 later removed the extension row from core R5 source when extensions moved out of the core checkout.
additional_context: Current core source still retains an OID for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/elementdefinition-graphConstraint but the ElementDefinition common extensions spreadsheet no longer contains a graphConstraint/GraphDefinition row. The maintained definition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-elementdefinition-graphConstraint.xml with context ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile, cardinality 0..1, and value canonical(GraphDefinition). FHIR-I minutes record the March 2022 decision to add an extension, but September 2022 minutes and Jira comments show the work was likely to reopen or be held pending assessment of ramifications. A 2023 Zulip profile-extension tooling survey listed elementdefinition-graphConstraint as not supported.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no FHIR core source changes. The only plausible remaining source change belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack and associated tooling, not this core checkout; broadening the current extension would also need FHIR-I/tooling review because the maintained artifact is narrower than FHIR-32798's current-resource/type.profile scope.
